title: The FAANGs Added $185 Billion in Market Value Today
text:

https://www.barrons.com/articles/faang-stocks-big-rally-185-billion-51545863880 The FAANGs Added $185 Billion in Market Value Today By Dec. 26, 2018 5:40 p.m. ET Order Reprints Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos Photograph by Alex Wong/Getty Images Text size
Wednesday was one of the market’s best days in a decade. The Dow Jones Industrial Average soared nearly 1,100 points, or 5%, and the Nasdaq Composite was up 5.8%. The infamous FAANG stocks— Facebook (FB), Apple (AAPL), Amazon.com (AMZN), Netflix (NFLX), and Google-parent Alphabet (GOOGL)—set the tempo. Amazon finished up a whopping 9.5%, adding $62.1 billion in market value. U.S. online spending this holiday season rose 19% over last year , with a bulk of that growth thanks to Amazon.
Meanwhile, a bullish analyst report helped Apple stock shake off some of its recent doldrums today to rise 7.0%, gaining $49.1 billion in market value. The FAANG group is closely watched because of its dominant technology, fast growth, and its market-leading gains for much of 2018, at least before the bull market rally ran out of steam this fall. During Wednesday’s relief rally, Alphabet’s value rose 6.4%, or $41.0 billion; Facebook increased 8.2%, or $24.3 billion; and Netflix climbed 8.5%, or $8.6 billion.
Add it all together and the FAANG gang is worth $185.1 billion more this evening than it was before the market opened. But zoom out a bit and the picture isn’t so pretty . Since their 2018 peaks, the group has shed over a trillion dollars in market value.
